project_type: Full-stack fraud detection: FastAPI backend + React+Vite frontend + Android Kotlin client
test_framework: pytest with httpx TestClient in backend/tests/, fixtures in conftest.py
build_command: No compile step for backend; frontend: npm run build
test_command: pytest tests/ --ignore=tests/test_m2_perception.py -v (381 passing tests must remain passing)
verification_instructions: Run pytest on new test files. Manually test streaming endpoints with curl. Verify frontend captures audio and polls /stream/chunk. Check Android permissions and network calls.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. All source files are committed; no build-generated artifacts checked in.
environment_constraints: Backend uses existing VoiceLayer singleton with Vansh180/deepfake-audio-wav2vec2 model. Model loading is lazy. Auth uses JWT (get_current_active_user dependency). CORS origins in settings.cors_origins_list. Upload dir is settings.upload_dir. Threading: use threading.Lock for session manager. Do NOT restart dev servers.
contribution_requirements: Append new routes to backend/app/api/routes/analyze.py (do NOT create separate file). Use existing patterns: FastAPI Depends for auth+DB, async def for endpoints, HTTPException for errors, background_tasks for async work. Frontend: follow existing Tailwind utility classes, lucide-react icons, apiClient singleton pattern. Android: follow coroutine/StateFlow patterns in VishwasViewModel, use existing VishwasApiService + Retrofit, request permissions via rememberLauncherForActivityResult.
key_patterns: Backend routes use @router decorators, get_current_active_user for auth, db: Session = Depends(get_db), return Pydantic response models. VoiceLayer._spoof_prob_for_window(samples: np.ndarray) -> float (samples are float32 normalized -1 to 1). Frontend api.ts uses async/await, getAuthToken() for Bearer header, returns T | null on error. Android uses Flow<Result<T>> in repository, fold(onSuccess, onFailure) in ViewModel.
